# Docs Route Revelation

The Awtsmoos turns a repository into teachable paths without confusing map and source; Awtsmoos.com therefore needs Docs to be simple at the first screen, deeply expandable underneath, and completely isolated from every neighboring route.

## Observed current architecture

- Entry: `geelooy/docs/index.html`.
- JS assembly: `geelooy/docs/modules/app.mjs`.
- Styles: eighteen direct route stylesheets; no route manifest.
- Primary shell already has the right conceptual pieces: sticky topbar, nav rail, main stage, context rail, command dialog, Ask dialog, toast.
- Mobile already turns the nav rail into an off-canvas drawer and moves search to a fixed bottom control.

## Confirmed debt

- `index.html` has no explicit Docs route identity on `html` or `body`.
- `tokens.css` uses `:root`, naked universal/document selectors, and generic form/link/selection selectors.
- `shell.css` uses route-global selectors and raw layers `1000` and `80`.
- `responsive.css` uses route-global selectors and raw mobile layers `65` and `70`.
- `components.css` provides hover/focus but lacks a systematic active/disabled covenant for action controls.
- `app.mjs` combines action creation, title policy, rendering generation, dataset startup, interactive layer setup, and error manifestation.
- `app.mjs` contains compressed arrow callbacks that violate the readability/documentation constitution if the file is touched.

## Architecture chosen

### CSS

- Add `data-geelooy-route="docs"` to both document roots only because tokens and document behavior genuinely require document-level selectors.
- Root every route-owned rule at `html[data-geelooy-route="docs"]` or `body[data-geelooy-route="docs"]`.
- Add route layer tokens to Docs tokens rather than retaining arbitrary numbers.
- Keep each existing stylesheet's conceptual responsibility unless its line budget or mixed responsibility proves a split is needed.
- Preserve print styles under the same route contract.

### JavaScript

Split `app.mjs` only if dependency tracing confirms stable seams:
- `DocsViewActionFactory.mjs`: constructs documented action callbacks.
- `DocsTitlePolicy.mjs`: pure title mapping.
- `DocsApplicationRuntime.mjs`: startup/render lifecycle and render-generation cancellation boundary.
- `app.mjs`: tiny dependency assembly and `start()` invocation only.

Use composition, not decorative inheritance: these are collaborators, not an is-a hierarchy.

## Files to inspect before production rewrite

- every `geelooy/docs/styles/*.css`
- `geelooy/docs/modules/elements.mjs`
- `geelooy/docs/modules/app-interactive.mjs`
- `geelooy/docs/modules/view-navigation.mjs`
- `geelooy/docs/modules/app-view-router.mjs`
- `geelooy/docs/modules/state.mjs`
- Docs tests and documentation artifacts if present

## Verification gate

- zero unscoped active Docs CSS rules
- zero raw nonlocal z-index values
- zero touched source files over the project ceiling
- tab indentation throughout touched files
- complete B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He / Awtsmoos / Awtsmoos.com covenants
- no one-line meaningful functions in touched JS
- existing URL/history/view behavior preserved
- search, Ask, theme, mobile nav, and toast contracts preserved
- static/browser tests where the adapter can prove results

## NEXT_ACTION

Map the full Docs CSS rule/layer census and read the six JS boundary modules before rewriting any Docs production file.
